## Summary

## Related issue / PR
- Fixes or closes: # (if applicable)

## Type of change

- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change

## Checklist
- [ ] I added tests that exercise the change and verified the test suite passes locally: `julia --project=. -e "using Pkg; Pkg.test()"`
- [ ] I added or updated documentation (README or `docs/`)
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` with a short note if this is a user-visible change
- [ ] I followed the project's coding conventions and formatted code where applicable

## Notes for reviewers
Provide any additional context, instructions to test, or implementation notes.

If this PR introduces a user-visible change (new feature or breaking change), please add a short changelog entry and consider a version bump in `Project.toml`.
